description: This file defines a React functional component named Navbar, which provides the navigation bar for the web application. It includes links to various pages such as Lessons, Quizzes, AI Game, Multiplayer, Leaderboards, Dashboard, Profile, and Admin, with visibility depending on user authentication status and user roles. It also manages login/logout actions.

methods.name: Navbar()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the application's navigation bar with authentication-aware links.
